A local-first TypeScript client for Google Sheets. This is a functional prototype; the Google adapter is covered by simulated HTTP contract tests, not live integration tests.

- Includes ready-to-use JavaScript and TypeScript declarations in `dist/`.
- No runtime dependencies or installation-time builds.
- English / Slovak documentation: https://fokot.github.io/sheetbase/
- Install this tag with `npm install github:fokot/sheetbase#TAG`, replacing `TAG` with the release tag, or install the attached `.tgz` URL.

Nothing is published to the npm registry. Fero Tracker is not integrated with this library.
